title: Stop deferral: typed background tasks and a ceiling that resets every turn
context: Review found that the frozen spec contradicts itself. FR-7 says turn end defers while any background task runs with a stage open. INV-1 says Stop and agent-blocking decisions stay as on main. INV-12 says a background task left open forever never ends a turn unjudged. The build removed main's typed-task guard (src/stage-evidence/completion-deferred.ts:91), so a non-paqad background agent or a background dev server with a stage open now defers the Stop check, where main judged it. The 30 minute ceiling ignores deferred rows from before the current turn (line 125), and a deferred Stop runs no finalize, so the open stage stays open. A task that never ends therefore defers the first Stop of every turn, and the change is never judged across turns. AC-39 only tests one turn. The checks-run marker deferral itself is sound.
